user_reported_faulty.reason: reported by the user as a wrong point on the map; coordinates nulled and the row kept for audit, per the same convention as water_quarantine. Previous revision of this file recorded it as verified_correct, which was not reproducible: Nominatim reverse-geocodes 37.003307/10.73375 to no feature at all, and the point is 13.5 km from the nearest other station in the seed, outside the area the surrounding SRTGN stops cluster in.

downloads_import.note: Only stops >150 m from any existing station were added.

downloads_transport_import.excluded: SNCFT level crossings, schools, farm tracks, line-name-only lists

bizerteconnect_import.stops_note: No public stops endpoint; 404 on bus-stops/, bus-stations/, stops/, stations/, bus-trips/. /trips/ and /season-schedules/ require auth. Lines therefore carry named endpoints + schedule.

unroutable_lines.reason: BizerteConnect publishes no stops endpoint; these lines carry named endpoints and schedules but no stops and no coordinates, so they are not graph edges.
